_comment: Interactive Blender only. This is ahujasid/blender-mcp, the community standard:
an add-on inside a RUNNING Blender GUI opens a socket on localhost:9876, and this
server bridges MCP calls to it.
Prerequisites, none of which a build host has: Blender installed with a display,
the addon.py from the blender-mcp repo installed via Edit > Preferences > Add-ons,
and 'Connect to MCP server' pressed in the 3D viewport's BlenderMCP sidebar tab.
It is kept OUT of servers.json on purpose — a server that cannot connect turns
every builder run into a startup failure. Pass it explicitly when Blender is up:
For unattended asset generation use src/lib/assets/blender.ts instead, which runs
blender --background and needs no display, no add-on and no human. That path reads
BLENDER_BIN from the environment — it never hardcodes an install path, so upgrading
Blender is a symlink flip at $HOME/.local/opt/blender and nothing here changes.
Install or upgrade it with: node --import ./scripts/missions-loader.mjs
